note: The tuning values the simulation decides by (ADR-016, decision 4). Each is a decimal string under a key named with its unit, as the design states it. Tools/BakeContent.py --server converts each exactly, through fractions.Fraction, into the simulation's unit and writes it into ServerData's RULE section under the converted key: meters to voxels and seconds to ticks, each of which must come out whole, and speeds and accelerations to Core::Fixed per tick, floored once. Tools/CheckAssets.py fails a value that does not convert. The values are the owner's of 2026-11-01 (GameDesign.md, M2's values), by item: spans 14; the warning 4; the fall's gravity 5; the shot and its craters 12; loose material 9; the navigation classes 10.
